stem:
Acute kidney injury (AKI) in coronavirus infection disease (COVID-19) is associated with disease severity.

Which one of the following descriptions about AKI in COVID-19 Patients is NOT CORRECT?

options.text: Global collapse of the glomerular tuft with overlying podocyte hyperplasia
Tubular microcystic dilation, and prominent tubular protein reabsorption droplets
Subendothelial electron-dense deposits, some associated with short glomerular basement membrane spikes
Cellular crescents, mesangial hypercellularity and segmental endocapillary hypercellularity

reconciliationNotes: 原始答案與兩組 NotebookLM 檢索結果完全一致。

stem:
A 70 years old woman who has ESRD from diabetes and received hemodialysis for 2 years. Fluctuation of her blood calcium level found by the physician. No dialysate calcium level (2.5adjusted in recent month. Traced her series data was below.
Dec. 03, 2016 | Mar. 05, 2017 | Jun.07, 2017 | Sep. 04, 2017
Ca (total, correct) (mg/dL): 9.2 | 7.7 | 9.1 | 6.8
Phosphate (mg/dL): 5.6 | 4.2 | 4.9 | 4.1
Intact PTH (pg/mL): 192 | 1203 | 259 | 1251
Which is the most probable cause for this condition?

options.text: Poor compliance of Phosphate binder and calcitriol prescribed
Teriparatide (Forteo) injected on the day Mar, 01, 2017 and Sep. 01, 2017
Took calcitriol (0.5µg, three times a week) since Mar. 2017 to Jan 2017, then discontinued.

reconciliationNotes: 原始答案與兩組 NotebookLM 檢索結果完全一致。
